name: Nicolive Oshi Watch
description: Checks every 3 minutes whether your favourite Niconico Live broadcasters are on air; when live it shows 🔴 title, elapsed time and viewer count with a one-tap "watching" post button. Just list up to 5 user IDs (the number in the profile URL) in the settings; no login or API key needed. Shows a timeshift hint within 1 hour after a broadcast ends, otherwise the last broadcast date. Unofficial API.
